title: Taco Bell Bong
blurb: Resonant, slightly hollow, and carrying more finality than a fast-food chain strictly needs. The bong that closes every Taco Bell advert somehow became a beloved editing tool. It functions as punctuation: whatever preceded it is now over and has been formally filed. Editors drop it after anything that could plausibly end a commercial, which turns out to be almost anything at all — a punchline, a life decision, a catastrophic failure delivered with total confidence. There is something quietly wonderful about the universe signing off on your nonsense with a branded gong.
origin: The gong sting from Taco Bell's commercials; adopted as an all-purpose closing punctuation.
